title: 第585章 我那么大一个清霄师兄呢？
content_zh:
“大乘修士？！”

清虚望着那两道人影，勃然色变。他刚破境晋入大道尊之位，还未真正展露锋芒，怎就迎头撞上两位浮黎大乘。

甚至.....他连对方施了何种手段，将自己挪移至此都不清楚。

“有趣，”日尊没有理会清虚，反而饶有兴趣地打量太真，说道：“你这胆小鬼，居然敢将本宫放入【妄尘大千

“是，我被车撞，身死，执念不灭，一直伴随着你，好久，好久了！”静的声音中有一种满足和幸福，但是柳毅却无比的苦涩，这一瞬间，他觉得自己是天下间最没用的人，保护不了自己所爱，她一直在自己身边却丝毫不知。

柳毅眼睛一眯，当初自己和道凡争夺地心炎莲，各自得到了一半，虽然着地心炎莲还未成熟，但是也绝对举世难寻的神药，为了一头不怎么样的异兽，那道凡居然肯将这一半拱手送给自己？

林取胜无言点头，那一点头仿佛岁月一下子从他年迈的脸上划过，苍老了不少。

沈若凭着服饰和腰间无香囊的识别认出了她是林悠然，当然了，即便她的身份是林成月，估计也不会有什么好态度。

月希的学院分岔口处，缪凯恩久久不见缪可蒂的身影，拨通了她的电话。

急忙往城门的方向走去，不想迎面撞上了胧沢，来不及躲藏，妍蔚转身就跑。

修士修炼第一步也都是引天地灵气入体，不过，不同于主宇宙地球，这个世界会有许多的劫难伴随着修士。

即使萧苒兮对眼前的这只蝴蝶有印象，不过当她真正看着它时，那种惊讶的感觉还是首次感受过。

回顾这三次强化念头的过程，他发现第一次最轻松，这一次也还算轻松，反而是给梁佳怡强化的那一次最难。

心烦的起身走到窗前，听着滴滴答答的雨声，心里愈发的躁‘乱’。

就算郭乐晴到时候多么能干，这种流言言论都可能给她带来阻碍。

而周南光和周双禄的经历，已经他们对国家的贡献，也是盛明远和林宛音敬佩的。

北院这边人非常多，季云起初还会担心有骚乱什么的，但看到有武警队员们在这里，也安心了很多。

沈音将心中的一些想法暂时压下去，巧儿是可以守护这个世界，但是有些人冒险起来可不在乎这里，他们可能会去外面制作了不好的东西，然后借用进口名义再运输进来，所以还是要防备一下的。

这个念头刚从我脑中闪过，停住的水流便一分为二，从两边向我和苗玲珑围拢过来。

“那你别说话，你声线辨识度太高了，他们很容易猜到是你的。”她在唇边做了个拉上拉链的动作。

听她这么一说，围观的百姓看着裴洛白的眼神全都变了，从同情纷纷变成了鄙夷与不屑。

盛安宁抱着墨墨哄着，心里却好奇，不知道极光怎么会进屋，她昨晚难道忘了插门？

反观顾南枝，天本就热，她这会更是心烦意乱的很，这个时候除了点头，她怎么说都是给顾家招惹祸端。

‘花’青衣从来没有遇到过像龙一这样的人，龙一这样的人很难缠，因为就算s们已经在上风了，s们还是想再上上风，s们不愿一点把柄被人握着，s们做任何事情都必须要自己掌握主动权。

看到自己的一对主人已经和好如初，诺亚由衷欣慰，笑吟吟和他们两个打过招呼，和顺的眼神看看德莫斯，又看看他身旁的卡蕾忒。
content_en:
"Mahayana monk?!"

Qingxu looked at the two figures and his expression suddenly changed.He had just broken through and advanced to the position of Dao Zun, and before he really showed his talents, he bumped into two Fu Li Mahayana head-on.

Even...he didn't even know what method the other party used to move him here.

"Interesting," Rizun ignored Qingxu. Instead, he looked at Taizhen with great interest and said, "You coward, how dare you put me in the [Wangchen Daqian]"

"Yes, I was hit by a car and died, but my obsession will never die. I have been with you for a long, long time!"There was a kind of satisfaction and happiness in Jing's voice, but Liu Yi was extremely bitter. At this moment, he felt that he was the most useless person in the world. He couldn't protect the one he loved. She was always by his side without knowing it.

Liu Yi narrowed his eyes. When he and Dao Fan competed for the Earth-centered Flame Lotus, each got half of it. Although the Earth-centered Flame Lotus was not yet mature, it was definitely a rare magical medicine. For a not-so-good beast, Dao Fan was actually willing to give half of it to him?

Lin Qusheng nodded silently, and that nod seemed as if time had suddenly passed by on his old face, making him look much older.

Shen Ruo recognized her as Lin Youran based on her clothes and the lack of a sachet on her waist. Of course, even if she was Lin Chengyue, she probably wouldn't have a good attitude.

At the fork in Yuexi's college, Miao Kane didn't see Muketi for a long time and dialed her phone.

She hurriedly walked towards the city gate, not wanting to run into Ouzawa head-on. Without enough time to hide, Yanwei turned around and ran away.

The first step of a monk's cultivation is to attract the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into his body. However, unlike the main universe and earth, this world will have many disasters accompanying the monks.

Even though Xiao Ranxi had an impression of the butterfly in front of her, when she actually looked at it, she felt the feeling of surprise for the first time.

Looking back at the process of strengthening his thoughts these three times, he found that the first time was the easiest, and this time was also relatively easy. On the contrary, the time he strengthened Liang Jiayi was the most difficult.

I got up upset and walked to the window. Listening to the dripping rain, my heart became more and more restless.

No matter how capable Guo Leqing is then, such rumors and remarks may bring obstacles to her.

The experiences of Zhou Nanguang and Zhou Shuanglu and their contributions to the country are also admired by Sheng Mingyuan and Lin Wanyin.

There were a lot of people in the North Campus, and Ji Yun was worried about riots at first, but seeing the armed police members here, he felt a lot more at ease.

Shen Yin temporarily suppressed some thoughts in his heart. Qiao'er can protect this world, but some people don't care about this place when they take risks. They may go outside to make bad things and then transport them in under the name of import, so they still have to be on guard.

As soon as this thought flashed through my mind, the stopped water split into two and surrounded Miao Linglong and me from both sides.

"Then don't say anything. Your voice is so recognisable, they can easily guess it's yours."She made a zipper motion on her lips.

Hearing what she said, the eyes of the people watching changed when they looked at Pei Luobai, from sympathy to contempt and disdain.

Sheng Anning hugged Mo Mo and coaxed her, but she was curious in her heart. She didn't know how Ji Guang came into the house. Did she forget to open the door last night?

Gu Nanzhi, on the other hand, was already very hot, so she was even more upset. At this time, except for nodding, no matter what she said, she would cause trouble for the Gu family.

'Hua' Qingyi has never met someone like Long Yi. People like Long Yi are very difficult to deal with, because even if they are already on the upper hand, they still want to gain the upper hand again. They don't want to be held by others. They must take the initiative in everything they do.

Seeing that his pair of masters had reconciled, Noah was sincerely relieved. He greeted them both with a smile, and looked at Deimos with gentle eyes, and then at Kalete beside him.
